changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Code Generation' as it's not the main NLG task (distractor generation is textual NLG). Simplified dataset names. Added Gemma-7B-It which is mentioned as a baseline. Normalized model names.
Normalized 'sBLEU' to 'BLEU' following the guideline to simplify variants to base form. Kept other metrics as is.
Normalized method names to more descriptive forms. Removed redundant 'Mistral-7B-Instruct'. The LLMs are used to evaluate distractor plausibility through various prompting methods.

The survey was designed to begin only after they agreed to provide their results for research purposes and acknowledged the precautions via an online form.

changes_made.explanation: Simplified guidelines to key evaluation procedures. Added missing criteria (Difficulty, Clarity, Answerability) mentioned in human evaluations. Normalized criteria capitalization.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on NLG for educational distractor generation. Extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and some additions from careful reading of the full text. The paper conducts comprehensive evaluation using both automatic metrics and human/LLM judges.
